snippet.title: Darkwing Duck remake NES (fan game). Release trailer
snippet.description:
It's fan game, it's for free. You can download game.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-qqZ4DiJY53D30eP9aEn14CWLtQqPWor?usp=drive_link

Some stuck can still happed(very rare), so X button can help

Changes since beta 2:
*calamity mod added
*main menu changed
*sound/music volume option added
*language/sound/music volume/mod/difficulty now saving 
*pause menu added
*you can restart/exit game/ change sound/music volume in pause menu
*optimization
*platforming fixes
*stuck fix(bridge level)
*darkness patern changed(sewers)
*grass visual changed(forest)
*background fixes(bridge,city,sewers,tower)
*dog ii fixed (Floating Fortress)
*Liquidator speed buffed
*Moliarty repair speed buffed
*walls added
*camera fixes
*for some enemies speed up 
*hard mode fixes
*other fixes

Cooming next... later.. or never:
As I finished with basic NES content I wanna add:
*levels
*characters
*bosses
*new mods
*more language support

And bug fixes... Since I was a lone tester during beta 2, some bugs still exist.

feedback e-mail: arankus@gmail.com
